svg.text: grey-green lichen ground, snow in the hollows, dark spruce thinning poleward to stunted scrub
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 24.2 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 22.3 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a black band through lichen and snow: the snow melted to dark wet ground,
the lichen burnt to grey crisp
a bowl of dark frozen soil with a ring of snow thrown out, ice lenses
spruce charred black and snow-capped, black circles where stunted scrub
burned, grey ash on the snow
C. Destruction in tundra and taiga: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). A snow burst: a pale powder cloud that rises and falls, white and blue crystal shards, dark soil clods under it.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
Sparse spruce on cold grass; lichen replaces the grass; the first snow patches
Tundra and taiga to Temperate forest
Broadleaf gives way to spruce; the trees shrink poleward; lichen and snow
Bare rock above, lichen and stunted scrub below, snow in the folds.
